items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Zito played this beautiful solo on.

ctx.x: I don't remember, so I may have been. I worked --

Well this was the year that they made the tune, I Got My Love to Keep me Warm and Jimmy Zito played this beautiful solo on. And they had the band played in something like the Green Room or Auditorium or something. Isn't there something like a reading room next to a food counter. See the food counter was right in back of the band room. And there was a room just before you got to the food counter. Just off of Vermont.
Oh, yeah, the music room was --
